extraction.title: Sub - Chapter Seeing Problems Differently - Rowan Gibson's Four Lenses
teaching_elements: Case studies (Airbnb, Netflix, Tesla, Uber, AWS, Intuit, Slack, M-Pesa)
Practical exercise (applying the four lenses to a challenge)
key_claims: Innovators need to look at problems through multiple lenses to uncover hidden opportunities.
Innovation begins not with solutions, but with finding the right problems to solve.

questions: But how do we actually spot the opportunities for innovation in the first place? How can we see possibilities where others see only fog?
What if messages could be delivered faster by other means? What if carriage designs could be improved for speed and comfort?
It's about having the courage to ask "Why?" and "What if?
What orthodoxies in your own field might be ripe for questioning? What beliefs are so ingrained that challenging them could unlock entirely new possibilities?
